bosses.name: Lucifron
bosses.general: Two Flamewaker Protectors with him mind control people: kill them first. Lucifron casts Impending Doom and Lucifron's Curse on the raid.
bosses.tank: One tank on each Protector, one on Lucifron facing away (Shadow Shock).
bosses.healer: Priests and paladins dispel Impending Doom; mages and druids remove the curse; free the mind controlled.

bosses.name: Magmadar
bosses.general: Panic fears everyone near him about every 30 seconds, Lava Bombs leave fire under players, and he goes into Frenzy.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward and Tremor Totem on you; tank him at the back so the raid sees his side.
bosses.healer: Stay out of fear range if you can; heal the tank hard through Frenzy.
bosses.dps: Hunters Tranquilizing Shot the Frenzy. Step out of Lava Bombs.

bosses.name: Gehennas
bosses.general: Two Flamewakers with him. Gehennas' Curse cuts healing by 75%, Rain of Fire on the raid, Shadow Bolt.
bosses.tank: Off-tanks take the Flamewakers (their Fist of Ragnaros stuns); main tank on Gehennas.
bosses.dps: Flamewakers first, then Gehennas. Move out of Rain of Fire.

bosses.name: Garr
bosses.general: Eight Firesworn: each one dying explodes and makes Garr stronger. Banish some, off-tank the rest, kill them one at a time away from the raid, then Garr.
bosses.tank: Main tank on Garr; off-tanks hold one Firesworn each.
bosses.healer: Garr's Antimagic Pulse strips everyone's buffs: buff the tanks again and heal the off-tanks.
bosses.dps: Kill the Firesworn one by one where the tank calls, step back when one is low.

bosses.name: Shazzrah
bosses.general: Blinks to a random player and casts Arcane Explosion around himself. Shazzrah's Curse doubles magic damage; Deaden Magic on himself.
bosses.tank: Run to him after every blink; threat resets.
bosses.dps: Purge or dispel Deaden Magic; ranged spread out.

bosses.name: Baron Geddon
bosses.general: Living Bomb: that player runs away from everyone before it blows. Inferno burns everyone near him. Ignite Mana drains mana: dispel it.
bosses.tank: Run out during Inferno, come back after.
bosses.healer: Dispel Ignite Mana; heal the bomb carrier.
bosses.dps: Run out with a bomb, out of Inferno; at the very end he explodes, move away.

bosses.name: Golemagg the Incinerator
bosses.general: Two Core Ragers: an off-tank holds them away, nobody attacks them (they die with him). Pyroblast on random players, Earthquake at 10%.
bosses.tank: Main tank on Golemagg (Magma Splash stacks); off-tank the two Ragers apart.
bosses.healer: Heal the Pyroblasts; the main tank takes stacking fire damage.
bosses.dps: Only Golemagg. Melee leave when he's at 10% (Earthquake).

bosses.name: Sulfuron Harbinger
bosses.general: Four Flamewaker Priests heal and cast Shadow Word: Pain: kill them first, interrupting Dark Mending.
bosses.tank: Off-tanks on the priests; main tank on Sulfuron (Hand of Ragnaros knocks back).
bosses.dps: Priests one by one, interrupt Dark Mending, then Sulfuron.

bosses.name: Majordomo Executus
bosses.general: He submits when his eight guards die: four Flamewaker Healers, four Elites. He shields them with Magic Reflection and Damage Shield.
bosses.tank: Tanks on the Elites; Majordomo teleports a tank into the fire now and then.
bosses.dps: Healers first, then Elites. Casters stop on Magic Reflection, melee on Damage Shield.

bosses.name: Ragnaros
bosses.general: Wrath of Ragnaros knocks back everyone in melee; with nobody in melee he hits the raid with Magma Blast. He submerges and eight Sons of Flame come: kill them.
bosses.tank: Two tanks: one takes over after a knockback. Keep someone in melee always.
bosses.healer: Fire resistance; heal the tanks through Elemental Fire.
bosses.dps: Melee behind him, ranged spread. Kill the Sons of Flame when he submerges.

trash.name: Core Hound
trash.general: A pack of five: a dead hound gets up again unless all five die within 10 seconds of each other. Bring them down evenly with area damage.
trash.healer: Heal the tanks: the pack hits hard.
trash.dps: Spread the damage evenly, then finish them together.

trash.name: Ancient Core Hound
trash.general: Lava Breath burns everyone in front of it; its bite leaves a random debuff.
trash.tank: Face it away from the group.
trash.dps: Stay at its side or behind it.

trash.name: Firelord
trash.general: Summons Lava Spawns that split in two if they live long; Soul Burn silences.
trash.dps: Kill the Lava Spawns as they appear, then the Firelord.

trash.name: Molten Giant
trash.general: Smash hits everyone near it, Knock Away throws its tank back.
trash.tank: Taunt it back after a knockback.
trash.dps: Ranged are safe; melee watch their threat.

trash.name: Molten Destroyer
trash.general: Massive Tremor hits everyone within 13 yards and stops their casts; Knockdown stuns.
trash.tank: Hold it away from the casters.
trash.dps: Casters stay more than 13 yards away.

trash.name: Lava Surger
trash.general: Surges into players at range: damage and a knockback where it lands.
trash.tank: Grab it again after each surge.

trash.name: Flameguard
trash.general: Cone of Fire in front of it, Fire Shield burns whoever hits it in melee, Melt Armor.
trash.tank: Face it away from the group.

trash.name: Lava Elemental
trash.general: Pyroclast Barrage stuns and burns everyone in front of it.
trash.tank: Face it away from the group.
